role: The Fortune/Looting/Luck-of-the-Sea family (effect ids 21, 35, 61): one class, three instances named by the EnumEnchantmentType passed to the constructor.
scope_reason: The enchanting table is a plain block (world.conf enchanting=off), but the enchantment registry itself is kept: loot books and mob equipment carry enchantments (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, 'Kept: enchantment data and effects').

members.name: EnchantmentLootBonus
members.note: the three rows carry the three setName branches: 'enchantment.lootBonus' (21), 'enchantment.lootBonusDigger' (35), 'enchantment.lootBonusFishing' (61)

members.name: canApplyTogether
members.note: lootBonus refuses silkTouch; encoded as bit j of CAN_APPLY_TOGETHER[i] in csrc/engine/enchants.h, read in the direction Java calls it (existing.canApplyTogether(candidate))
